transfer_condition: heldout action-state intervention combinations not present in training episodes
counterfactual_condition: same surface state with changed intervention consequence and different surface state with same consequence
leakage_risk_reduced: static key, action-label, and row-index recovery

transfer_condition: new transition compositions or perturbations not present in training
counterfactual_condition: same observation bag with changed transition relation and different surface with matched predictive relation

transfer_condition: new episode context after consolidation where direct answer retrieval is insufficient
counterfactual_condition: same replay records with shuffled causal order and same serialized state with changed heldout observation
leakage_risk_reduced: cache replay, stored-answer replay, and hash-only replay

transfer_condition: new variables or intervention pairings not seen in training
counterfactual_condition: same variable handle with changed controllability and different handle with matched controllability response
leakage_risk_reduced: name, role, and static partition leakage

transfer_condition: changed consequence mapping or delayed-effect condition not present in training
counterfactual_condition: same immediate reward with changed delayed consequence and same state-action pair with changed viability pressure
leakage_risk_reduced: static reward lookup and myopic policy shortcuts

transfer_condition: unseen partners plus counterfactual partner-latent swaps
counterfactual_condition: same-ID/different-latent and different-ID/same-latent partner pairs with identity-key permutation
leakage_risk_reduced: partner-ID, profile-table, history, retrieval, graph/cache, and full-bundle decoder shortcuts
